raw_segments.text: Kodik made his dolphin jump in the air and shouted as loud as he could.
He knew that Cevich never caught a fish in his life, but always rooted for clams and
seaweed, though he pretended to be a very terrible person.
Naturally the chickies and the gooverooskies and the Epochas the Burgomaster gulls, and

And so Limershin told me for nearly five minutes you could not have heard a gun fired on water.
All the population was yelling and screaming, clam eater, steric old man, while Cevich rolled
